message.content:
Adversarially verify this code-review finding from the M12 diff. Read the actual code (git diff main...HEAD + the file) and try to REFUTE it. Default to isReal=false if it's a false positive, pre-existing, out of scope, or already handled.

Lens: money
Severity: low
File: app/(customer)/account/page.tsx (upcoming list filter (line ~77-78) + components/customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx cancel button (lines 84-100))
Title: In-progress bookings render a Cancel button that always fails
Detail: The account page builds `upcoming` from bookings with status `confirmed` OR `in_progress` and passes them to UpcomingBookings. UpcomingItem carries no status, so UpcomingBookings renders a Cancel button for every item including in-progress sessions. cancelBooking guards `status !== 'confirmed'` and returns `{ok:false, error:'This booking can't be cancelled.'}`, so an in-progress cancel just surfaces an error toast. No money is mis-handled (the server guard correctly refuses), but offering a Cancel/Reschedule action that can never succeed for an active session is a UX defect on the M12 dashboard.
Suggestion: Pass the booking status (or an `isActive` flag) through UpcomingItem and hide Cancel/Reschedule for `in_progress` items (show only Join), or filter in-progress bookings out of the cancel-eligible list.
